frequency_question: How often do announced or proposed industrial/transport financial incentive schemes proceed to formal gazette notification and implementation within a 273-day window?
membership_rule: Includes central government ministry-led financial incentive, subsidy, or credit guarantee schemes targeting specific vehicle categories or industrial sectors in large emerging economies. Excludes minor amendments, broad budget allocations without operational guidelines, or purely state-level policies.

cases.name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Automobile and Auto Components
PLI Scheme for Advanced Chemistry Cell (ACC) Battery Storage
National Green Hydrogen Mission Financial Incentive Framework
PM e-Drive Scheme (successor to FAME II for e-vehicles)
National Electric Mobility Mission Plan (NEMMP) 2020 Implementation Rules

coverage_note: 8 major federal automotive and clean tech manufacturing/subsidy schemes identified; all advanced signals successfully proceeded to formal notification within the window.
known_gaps: Some smaller sub-schemes or localized pilot programs may have experienced delays or cancellation, but major national framework schemes for automotive/EV sectors have a near 100% conversion rate once formally proposed and advanced.
validity_reason: Policy implementation velocity and bureaucratic frameworks for industrial subsidies remain stable under current administrative machinery through the decade.
